title: Use the exact ordered dual witness for full-CPTP extractor optimality
statement: With Cj=N(sigmaj/2), a full-gauge fixed extractor B is optimal over all CPTP decoders iff YB=sum_j Cj Bj is Hermitian and QB=I tensor YB-sum_j sigmaj^T tensor Cj>=0. A strict dual gap gives objective curvature mu/8 and fidelity curvature mu/32 times squared generator discrepancy; it does not give fidelity near one.
